change_summary: Compress stale, already-consumed bulky tool outputs (get_product_details/get_order_details) in replayed history while keeping system prompt and the 2 most recent tool results intact.
reason_for_change: Tasks 20/99/103 fetch multiple large multi-variant product blobs plus order blobs that pass-through build_messages replays in full every turn across 34-35 turn conversations, inflating cumulative context tokens. Replacing only stale (non-recent) large blobs with a short marker cuts replayed input tokens on exactly these long/high-tool tasks, lowering mean cost per task; the system prompt, recent tool results, and all decision-relevant recent context remain verbatim so success is preserved, and the tool remains callable if the details are needed again.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.5000 < floor 0.6333
hypothesis: get_product_details returns large multi-variant JSON blobs that get carried in full history for the rest of the conversation; compressing/truncating stale tool results in history once they've been used lowers cumulative context tokens on later turns.
